findings.evidence: template/scripts/publication_state.py:183–187 adds GET commits/{head}/check-runs, called for App-bound requirements at lines 241–242. This endpoint requires Checks read permission ([GitHub documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/checks/runs#list-check-runs-for-a-git-reference)). .github/workflows/publication-queue.yml:35–43 requests only Contents write and Pull requests write. Consequently, the coordinator receives a transport failure instead of a passed required-checks gate, preventing affected contributions from progressing.
findings.summary: App-bound contribution checks cannot be observed with the publication worker’s token on private repositories.

findings.evidence: template/scripts/publication_queue.py:94–108 validates read_platform_config’s merged result. template/scripts/_platform_common.py:211–216 merges operator values over project values before returning it. A read-only, in-memory reproduction with project `publication = "invalid"`, an enabled operator config, and operator `[publication] coordinator_app = "operator-app"` returned `['operator-app']` without error. The invalid configured project source is therefore silently accepted; similarly, an invalid project coordinator_app can be overwritten before validation.
findings.summary: Operator overrides can hide invalid project trust configuration, bypassing the new fail-closed validation.
